title: EncryptionSpec
description: Represents a customer-managed encryption key spec that can be applied to a resource.

kmsKeyName.description: Required. The resource name of customer-managed encryption key that is used to secure a resource and its sub-resources. Only the key in the same location as this Dataset is allowed to be used for encryption. Format is: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/keyRings/{keyRing}/cryptoKeys/{key}`
